name: crud-usuarios-react-angular
description: Backend Node.js + SQL Server con dos frontends: React y Angular

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix react-frontend install && npm --prefix angular-frontend install && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,react,angular -c yellow,cyan,red "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix react-frontend run dev" "npm --prefix angular-frontend start -- --port 4200"
